decision: Retain native attention. SDPA median 1356.30 examples/s versus native 1486.39 (-8.75%). Both reversed timing rounds agree. This adapter misses the required 5% speed gain and uses more peak allocated memory. No quality pilot or production adoption is justified for this version.
compute: Whole benchmark process 29.35 seconds, excluding allocation, Drive mounting and installation. RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, BF16, batch128, identical 8192 original examples in each timed run. Profile reports both efficient-attention and math kernels.
scope: Disposable scratch model throughput only; all probe weights discarded. No new checkpoint or bot submission.
limitations: CPU numerical equivalence is not a full GPU numerical or quality guarantee.
Short single-GPU measurements do not establish optimal kernels or inference performance.
Other fused-attention adaptations may behave differently, especially at longer sequence lengths.
